review: Read all five new sources and nine application obligations, README and DERIVATION, plus the actual earlier interval overlap, quadratic shift cancellation, signed completion, complete logarithmic kernel, minor Dirichlet producer and original rectangular four-moment consumer. Read pinned finite fiberwise summation (to_additive source), conjugate norm, positive log monotonicity and real square-root APIs. Existing ingredients are genuinely consumed, not claimed newly invented.

The ordered-pair square is first regrouped exactly by h=x-y over the full integer displacement interval. The actual inverse is the second coordinate y, and the forward map is (h+y,y). Both endpoints and h=0 are retained. Even the first theorem permits negative H only when its bounded interval is necessarily empty; later length/cap consumers explicitly require H nonnegative.

The exact overlap is the consecutive interval with max/min endpoints. Its toNat length is bounded by 2H+1 including empty overlaps. The actual paired quadratic phase is the earlier correlation at frequency 2*c*h. Resonance retains the full length rather than using an invalid reciprocal chord. Nonresonance enlarges only the length in min(length,2/chord). No sparse subset is treated as a consecutive interval for cancellation.

The signed coefficient map h to c*h is injective precisely under c nonzero and lands in the interval at abs(c)*H. Nonnegative completion gives the exact prior completeEvenKernel. No coprimality of c and the approximant denominator is assumed, and all factors 2 and 16 are retained.

The logarithmic product is expanded before denominator bounds. The four terms are exactly 32*K*L/q, 32*K*(1+log q), 4*L and 4*q*(1+log q). Positive n<=q<=Q, q an integer at least one, and nonnegative K,L justify every replacement. This avoids the false K*Q/n loss. Nonnegative budget is proved before square-root consumption.

The same original minorDomain supplies a reduced a/q with N<q<=Q and q^-2 error at every minor point. Canonical Q=ceil(B^2/N) is produced by the earlier strict-width lemma; no irrationality or denominator-distribution premise is inserted. N>0, B>0 and (N+1)^3<=B remain explicit. The result is uniform over every pair of interval endpoints but does not integrate a prefix maximum.

The actual original unweighted rectangle consumer receives c=-kappa and the produced square-root bound. kappa nonzero is now needed for this fifth-factor cancellation, unlike the older supplied-bound consumer. First four sets may be arbitrary bounded subsets since their moments, not interval cancellation, are used. Final theorem constructs all four subset premises from its ten explicit endpoint inequalities. delta>0 remains explicit for the moment budget.

Independently reran the exact finite regression: 2500 complete interval squares, 32900 overlap phase/length identities, 3456 expanded range-budget comparisons, 42 signed injections, 90 actual rational minor witnesses and four negative controls passed. Verified all 1265 predecessor sources byte-exact, all source/evidence/producer hashes and 1270-source structural closure. These checks are not Lean elaboration or an asymptotic proof.
